XaeroTools
        Token for — shown once, copy it now:
        Token management is local-only — generate tokens on the server box (open this map there, or run xaerotools tokens generate).
        1. Install the XaeroTools Companion addon (Meteor Client).
        2. Enable XaeroTools Sync, paste the URL and a token.
        3. .xt sync once uploads the whole local map; new mapping streams automatically.
        Beyond a trusted LAN, share only over a VPN (Tailscale) or a TLS proxy.
          Offline mirror

            Merge map folders

            Combines two Xaero archives into a fresh output folder — regions merged tile by tile on conflicts, caches skipped, XaeroPlus DBs and waypoints merged too. Your sources are never modified. Nothing is written until Apply.

            Merge XaeroPlus databases

            NewChunks / OldChunks / Portals / … highlight DBs, schema v0/v1/v2 aware, oldest first-seen wins so your history is preserved. The output is a fresh copy of Base; Base and all sources stay untouched.
